chunks: And Abul-Abbās narrated to me from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusain, from Ṣafwān ibn Yaḥyā, from Ibn Muskān, from Abū ‘Abdillāh (peace be upon him) who said:
Whoever visits the grave of al-Ḥusain (peace be upon him), knowing his right, Allāh will forgive him what preceded of his sin and what followed.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting the grave of Imam Husain with knowledge of his rights?
ai.summary: In Kamil al-Ziyarat, Ibn Qulawayh highlights that the efficacy of visiting Imam al-Ḥusain’s (a.s.) grave hinges on 'ma'rifah' (gnostic recognition) of his specific rights, a concept central to Shia devotional theology. This visitation serves as a means of spiritual purification, granting comprehensive forgiveness of sins, thereby linking physical pilgrimage with inner spiritual awareness.
